Seamless tileable texture of a wet mortared rubble-stone embankment on the Yangtze riverbank in Yichang, China, at night. Irregular grey and brown stone blocks set in visible mortar joints, gently sloping surface, dark waterline staining along one edge, thin green algae and moss in the joints, a few shallow puddles reflecting faint warm light, rain-soaked sheen. No steps, no railing, no people, no boats, no text, no signs. Straight-on view, flat even light, photorealistic, high detail, tileable in both directions, muted cool grey with subtle warm reflections.
